plainText:
Jenny Yokobori is an American actress for the English-language dub of and . She is currently affiliated with Atlas Talent Agency.

==Biography==
Yokobori is an American voice actor born on February 11, 1997. Yokobori first became a voice actress in 2014 and went on to voice numerous characters. Yokobori joined the franchise during , voicing Goh's friend and Project Mew rival Horace.
